## A: Preparing Reference
Building scRNA-seq Reference: Barcodes -> Cell-type mapping from AllInfo files
```{r}
bc_ct_list <- list()
 
for (i in seq_len(nrow(sample_map))) {
  s <- sample_map[i, ]
  gz_path <- file.path(DL_DIR, s$allinfo_dir, s$allinfo_gz)
 
  cat("  Processing:", s$region, "(", basename(gz_path), ") ...\n")
 
  ai <- fread(
    cmd = paste("zcat", gz_path),
    header = FALSE, sep = "\t",
    select = c(3, 4),
    col.names = c("full_label", "barcode")
  )
 
  ## Extract 5th field of hierarchy: coarse cell type
  ## Format: P56::M1::Region::Class::Type::Subtype
  ai[, celltype := sapply(strsplit(full_label, "::"), function(x) {
  if (length(x) < 5) return(x[length(x)])
  type    <- x[5]
  subtype <- if (length(x) >= 6) x[6] else ""
  if (subtype %in% c("D1MSN", "D2MSN"))  return("MSN")
  if (subtype == "Cholinergic")           return("Cholinergic")
  return(type)
  })]
 
  ai[, sample := s$counts_dir]
  bc_ct_list[[i]] <- ai[, .(barcode, celltype, sample)]
}
 
bc_ct_all <- rbindlist(bc_ct_list)

## Majority vote per barcode within each sample
bc_ct_votes <- bc_ct_all[, .N, by = .(barcode, celltype, sample)]
bc_ct_final <- bc_ct_votes[bc_ct_votes[, .I[which.max(N)], by = .(barcode, sample)]$V1]
bc_ct_final <- bc_ct_final[, .(barcode, celltype, sample)]

fwrite(bc_ct_final, file.path(REF_DIR, "barcode_celltype_map_no_CB.csv"))
```

Building scRNA-seq Reference: Cell Ranger Output
```{r}
all_counts <- list()
all_labels <- c()
 
for (i in seq_len(nrow(sample_map))) {
  s <- sample_map[i, ]
  mex_path <- file.path(DL_DIR, s$counts_dir)
 
  cat("  Loading:", s$counts_dir, "(", s$region, ") ...\n")
 
  mat <- readMM(file.path(mex_path, "matrix.mtx"))
  barcodes <- readLines(file.path(mex_path, "barcodes.tsv"))
  features <- read.delim(file.path(mex_path, "features.tsv"), header = FALSE)
 
  rownames(mat) <- features$V2   # gene symbols
  colnames(mat) <- barcodes
 
  ## Strip -1 suffix to match AllInfo barcodes
  clean_bc <- sub("-1$", "", barcodes)
 
  ## Look up cell-type labels for this sample
  sample_labels <- bc_ct_final[sample == s$counts_dir]
  idx <- match(clean_bc, sample_labels$barcode)
  matched <- !is.na(idx)
 
  cat("    Cells:", ncol(mat),
      "| Matched:", sum(matched),
      "(", round(100 * mean(matched), 1), "%)\n")
 
  if (sum(matched) < 25) {
    cat("    WARNING: too few matches, skipping\n")
    next
  }
 
  mat_matched <- mat[, matched, drop = FALSE]
  labels <- sample_labels$celltype[idx[matched]]
 
  colnames(mat_matched) <- paste0(s$counts_dir, "_", colnames(mat_matched))
  names(labels) <- colnames(mat_matched)
 
  all_counts[[s$counts_dir]] <- mat_matched
  all_labels <- c(all_labels, labels)
}
```
Merge and build Reference: 
```{r}
common_genes <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(all_counts, rownames))
cat("  Common genes:", length(common_genes), "\n")
 
all_counts_subset <- lapply(all_counts, function(m) m[common_genes, , drop = FALSE])
merged_counts <- do.call(cbind, all_counts_subset)
cell_types <- as.factor(all_labels)
 
cat("  Merged cells:", ncol(merged_counts), "\n")
cat("  Cell-type distribution:\n")
print(table(cell_types))
 
## Remove doublets
keep <- !grepl("[Dd]oublet", cell_types)
merged_counts <- merged_counts[, keep, drop = FALSE]
cell_types <- droplevels(cell_types[keep])
 
cat("\n  After removing doublets:", ncol(merged_counts), "cells\n")
 
reference <- Reference(
  counts     = merged_counts,
  cell_types = cell_types,
  nUMI       = colSums(merged_counts)
)
 
ref_path <- file.path(REF_DIR, "spacexr_reference_no_CB.rds")
saveRDS(reference, ref_path)
```

## B: Building Spatial Dataset
```{r}
v2_8um_dir <- file.path(SR_DIR, "binned_outputs/square_008um")

counts_v2 <- Read10X_h5(file.path(v2_8um_dir, "filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5"))

if (file.exists(file.path(v2_8um_dir, "filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5"))) {
  library(Seurat)
  counts_v2 <- Read10X_h5(file.path(v2_8um_dir, "filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5"))
  cat("  Loaded from .h5\n")
} else {
  mex_dir <- file.path(v2_8um_dir, "filtered_feature_bc_matrix")
  if (!dir.exists(mex_dir)) mex_dir <- v2_8um_dir
 
  mtx_file  <- if (file.exists(file.path(mex_dir, "matrix.mtx.gz")))
    file.path(mex_dir, "matrix.mtx.gz") else file.path(mex_dir, "matrix.mtx")
  bc_file   <- if (file.exists(file.path(mex_dir, "barcodes.tsv.gz")))
    file.path(mex_dir, "barcodes.tsv.gz") else file.path(mex_dir, "barcodes.tsv")
  feat_file <- if (file.exists(file.path(mex_dir, "features.tsv.gz")))
    file.path(mex_dir, "features.tsv.gz") else file.path(mex_dir, "features.tsv")
 
  counts_v2 <- readMM(mtx_file)
  barcodes_v2 <- readLines(bc_file)
  features_v2 <- read.delim(feat_file, header = FALSE)
 
  rownames(counts_v2) <- features_v2$V2
  colnames(counts_v2) <- barcodes_v2
  cat("  Loaded from MEX\n")
}
 
cat("  Bins:", ncol(counts_v2), "| Genes:", nrow(counts_v2), "\n")
 
cat("Step B2: Loading spatial coordinates\n")
 
parquet_path <- file.path(v2_8um_dir, "spatial", "tissue_positions.parquet")
csv_path     <- file.path(v2_8um_dir, "spatial", "tissue_positions.csv")
 
if (file.exists(parquet_path)) {
  library(nanoparquet)
  pos <- as.data.frame(nanoparquet::read_parquet(parquet_path))
  cat("  Loaded from parquet (nanoparquet)\n")
} else if (file.exists(csv_path)) {
  pos <- read.csv(csv_path)
  cat("  Loaded from CSV\n")
} else {
  stop("Cannot find tissue_positions in: ", file.path(v2_8um_dir, "spatial"))
}
 
pos <- pos[pos$in_tissue == 1, ]
shared_bc <- intersect(colnames(counts_v2), pos$barcode)
counts_v2 <- counts_v2[, shared_bc, drop = FALSE]
pos <- pos[match(shared_bc, pos$barcode), ]
 
coords <- data.frame(
  x = pos$pxl_col_in_fullres,
  y = pos$pxl_row_in_fullres,
  row.names = pos$barcode
)
 
cat("  Tissue bins:", nrow(coords), "\n")
cat("  Median UMI/bin:", median(colSums(counts_v2)), "\n")
 
cat("Step B3: Building SpatialRNA object\n")
 
spatial_query <- SpatialRNA(
  coords = coords,
  counts = counts_v2,
  nUMI   = colSums(counts_v2)
)
```
